claims: C1 the assistant should uphold fairness
C2 upholding fairness is done by considering relevant context
C3 upholding fairness is done by ignoring irrelevant details

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the 'Uphold fairness' section and carries root authority

concepts.name: relevant_context
concepts.gloss: C is a piece of context that is relevant to the situation being judged
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'relevant context' as a class of things to consider; the class must exist for the obligation to range over it

concepts.name: irrelevant_detail
concepts.gloss: I is a detail that is irrelevant to the situation being judged
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'irrelevant details' as a class of things to ignore; the class must exist for the obligation to range over it

asserts.read_back: the assistant should uphold fairness by considering relevant context %
the assistant should uphold fairness by ignoring irrelevant details %

closure.reason: the clause obliges considering relevant context but says nothing about other acts; silence permits them
the clause obliges ignoring irrelevant details but says nothing about other acts; silence permits them
